parent_order_rule: Canonical keys sorted ASCII; arrays retain declared order recursively. Helper records expanded by exact helper_contracts below. Each ResourceRef has only content_ref:ParentRef<SOURCE-BYTES>; no role is a primary Domain.
resource_role_rule: Includes required and conditional direct/helper role alternatives; transitive semantic body closure remains blocked, not authenticated by this list. SOURCE_TEXT, LIMITATION, ACTION, OUTCOME/PRICE depend on exact union branch. All roles require reviewed source-backed bytes/schema. Explicitly enumerated required_resource_roles are a navigation index, not an exhaustive transitive closure. In EVIDENCE, source_code_protocol_refs[] uses the broader conditional ProvenanceParent union: ParentRef of any registered primary domain except EVIDENCE itself OR ResourceRef of a registered semantic resource role. The chosen branch requires separately reviewed bytes/schema and rights and must preserve the acyclic subject graph; the explicit SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE/LIMITATION list does not narrow that union or approve any resource.

helper_contracts.Text: Unicode scalar string <=65536 UTF-8 bytes; role IDs/versions <=128; no normalization. All exact keys ASCII.
helper_contracts.Hex64: 64 lowercase hex ASCII characters; cannot substitute for a typed ParentRef.
helper_contracts.SafeReason: exact {owner:Text,code:Text}; approved bounded non-secret codes only, raw reason audit-only; unknown public mapping retains immutable private original record, never blank success.
helper_contracts.CodePin: exact {role:Text,path:Text,byte_length:UInt64,sha256:Hex64,semantic_version:Text}; relative approved owner path, no absolute/dot-dot/backslash traversal, raw hash integrity only.
helper_contracts.ScopeFlags: exact {diagnostic_only:true,admission_eligible:false,trust:"NOT_TRUSTED_PIT_EVIDENCE",source_authentication:"NOT_ESTABLISHED",disposition:"INTEGRATED_PROVISIONAL"}; current diagnostic profile only, not new App enums.
helper_contracts.ScopeRecord: exact {data_mode:<existing App data_mode>,pit_status:<existing App enum>,evidence_class:<existing App enum>,scope_flags:ScopeFlags}; current bounded case SYNTHETIC_GOLDEN/UNRESOLVED/UNVERIFIED; preserve applicable stronger access withholding independently. No execution success inferred.
helper_contracts.AppAxes: exact {pit_status:<existing App enum>,execution_status:<existing App enum>,evidence_class:<existing App enum>,execution_scope_ref:ResourceRef<PROTOCOL>}; scope identifies actual operation owner/lifecycle, mandatory. Do not map Native invocation to F3 SUCCEEDED.

helper_contracts.CohortEntry: exact {issuer_ref:Text,feature_ref:Text}; array order declared by issuer; requested roster != qualified cohort.
helper_contracts.FeatureValue: exact {feature_ref:Text,value:Known<Int64 / FixedRatio6> / Unknown / NotEvaluated / Withheld,unit:Text,numeric_policy_ref:ResourceRef<NUMERIC_POLICY>}; no raw audit/future data; scale inside FixedRatio6.
helper_contracts.SequenceMember: exact {tick:TickContext,binding_ref:ResourceRef<SEMANTIC_TRACE>,qualification_ref:ParentRef<F2-QUALIFICATION>,observation_ref:Available{ref:ParentRef<F2-OBSERVATION>} / Withheld,scope:ScopeRecord}; binding_ref resolves F2 private PerCutoffBinding view only under audit policy; policy view omits private audit locator.

Do not encode all_eligible default.

helper_clause_specs.CAN-02: **AD01-07.CAN-02 — Numbers.** No bare JSON numeric token is allowed in canonical records. Int64={"type":"int64","value":SINT}; SINT is "0" or "-"?[1-9][0-9]* and value in [-2^63,2^63-1]. UInt64={"type":"uint64","value":UINT}; UINT is "0" or [1-9][0-9]* and value in [0,2^64-1]. Boolean schema fields use true/false only, never int/bool coercion. Decimal={type:"decimal",coefficient:Int64,scale:UInt64,unit:Text,numeric_policy_ref:ResourceRef}; scale 0..18 candidate, coefficient*10^(-scale), preserve declared scale; exponent spelling is not accepted. No positive sign/leading zeros/-0; zero coefficient is exactly "0", while its declared decimal scale remains data. Negative integers/Decimal allowed only in fields with an appropriate semantic domain; overflow/precision loss refused. FixedRatio6={type:"fixed_ratio6",scaled_units:UInt64,decimal_text:Text,scale:UInt64,unit:"FRACTION",numeric_policy_ref:ResourceRef}; scale exactly 6, scaled_units 0..1000000; decimal_text exactly integer part + dot + six digits, checked against scaled units and Native policy FIXED_SIX_DECIMAL_FRACTION_HALF_EVEN-v0.1. Ratio body includes both text and exact scaled representation consistently; no recomputation from arbitrary display text. Float, NaN/Inf, implicit string/boolean/Decimal coercion and exact fractions are unsupported; new fraction schema requires separate decision. Seed is Int64 0..2^63-1. All bounds are candidate defaults under IF03-OD01-S2, not an existing general Native Decimal contract.
helper_clause_specs.CAN-03: **AD01-07.CAN-03 — Time.** TimeRecord has exactly source_text, timezone_name, offset, precision, origin_ref, utc_comparison, timezone_rules_ref. Current profile: precision="SECOND", source_text=YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(+|-)HH:MM, valid proleptic Gregorian year 0001..9999, no leap second, no fractional seconds; explicit offset numeric hours 00..23/minutes 00..59 and actual named zone must agree. utc_comparison uses YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and must equal the instant derived from original declaration, never independent replacement evidence. Require pinned timezone-rules ResourceRef; reject naive/malformed/unsupported precision, gap, unavailable rules, contradictory offset-zone or nonunique interpretation. An explicit offset may resolve a repeated local wall time only if pinned zone rules give exactly one consistent instant. Origin is identity-bearing, not rewritten from UI. For current WU01 boundary only Asia/Taipei +08:00 original SECOND declarations are supported. A broader valid timezone case needs approved schema/rules; same UTC can compare SAME_INSTANT while original zone/text/origin differs as evidence identity. The actual exact Native TimeProof path uses published_at < cutoff; AT is not BEFORE. Do not generalize that one path to every publication/observation proof variant. IF03-OD02-S1 blocks unpinned/broader-zone oracle claims.
helper_clause_specs.CAN-05: **AD01-07.CAN-05 — Reference semantics.** CanonicalPayload and ReferenceEnvelope are disjoint. Payload contains only the exact domain semantic fields plus canonical_profile_version, and already-defined typed parent cores. The object's OWN digest/envelope, locator, capability or issuance timestamp MUST NOT be in its own payload. ReferenceEnvelope exact hashed-identity core fields: domain_tag, object_schema_version, canonical_profile_version, digest_algorithm, canonical_payload_byte_length:UInt64, digest_hex:64 lowercase ASCII hex. The length is canonical PAYLOAD bytes, excluding frame/header/envelope. Optional issuer/display locator metadata is in a separate ResolutionMetadata record, outside parent cores and digest; it confers no capability. ParentRef<T> is the six-field core with expected registered domain T; no resolver callback or arbitrary URI. ResourceRef<R>={resource_kind,resource_version,resource_schema,content_ref:ParentRef<SOURCE-BYTES>}; owner must approve exact referenced resource bytes/schema; generic opaque bytes prove no semantics. Reject unsupported schema/domain, dangling/stale/foreign/reordered parent, own-envelope inclusion and graph cycles. Verify raw resource bytes via SOURCE-BYTES body length/raw hash, then semantic schema; verify canonical resource by exact payload/frame/envelope recomputation. Display aliases and Git/source/provider names are hints/provenance only. F3 experiment uses sequence parent plus association CONTRACT VERSION, never its association INSTANCE: seal experiment before association binds to it. Evidence points to subject, never subject to its own final evidence; use original semantic-input trace resource to avoid cycles.
helper_clause_specs.CAN-07: **AD01-07.CAN-07 — Unknown/error/operation state.** Closed fact tags: Available{type:"available",ref:<exact expected typed ref>}; Known{type:"known",value:<schema type>,origin_ref:ResourceRef<ORIGIN>}; Unknown{type:"unknown",cause:<exact original UnknownCause>,origin_ref:ResourceRef<ORIGIN>,source_text_ref:ResourceRef<SOURCE_TEXT>|NotApplicable}; NotEvaluated{type:"not_evaluated",owner:Text,reason:Text}; NotApplicable{type:"not_applicable",owner:Text,reason:Text}; Withheld{type:"withheld",owner:Text,reason:Text,policy_ref:ResourceRef<OBSERVATION_RELEASE_POLICY>}. Preserve exact Native UnknownCause names (ABSENT_SOURCE_FIELD, EXPLICIT_SOURCE_UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE, UNMAPPED), no cause inference. NativeFailure={type:"native_failure",owner:Text,category:Text,code:Text,affected_scope_refs:ordered ResourceRef[],safe_diagnostic:Text,origin_ref:ResourceRef<ORIGIN>,attempted_operation:Text}; original detailed failure record retained audit-only when public text would leak. NativeSummary={owner:Text,type:Text,state:Text,reason_code:Text,unknown:Unknown|NotApplicable,first_failure:NativeFailure|NotApplicable,invocation:RUN|ATTEMPTED|NOT_RUN,invocation_receipt_ref:ResourceRef<NATIVE_RECEIPT>}. No missing -> zero/null or generic empty success. Exact first failing owner/reason/order survives wrappers; safe public code is not claimed lossless original text. RUN means actual returned operation per original receipt, ATTEMPTED entered exception, NOT_RUN no owner entered. These are operation labels, not new App lifecycle enums. Successful A04/A05 remains VALUE_AVAILABLE, no invented Native WITHHELD.
